szoveg_eredeti:
Get started with the Data plugin in ChatGPT. Take a quick tour of how to ask questions about your data, create visualizations, build dashboards, and share reports with your team.

See where to find Data in the plugin marketplace, how it works with your files and connected tools, and the skills available for tasks like checking data quality, defining KPIs, and business analysis.

Explore the Data plugin:
https://chatgpt.com/plugins/Plugin_fc9843a6fb34819195d6c7802398a8a7

Plugin availability depends on your workspace settings.

Part 1 of the Data Agent series.
